description:
[Tasks] Without task_id: create a task (title, notes, due date, assignee, about a candidate, application or position). With task_id: change the fields you send, or the status (done, cancelled; a cancelled task stays cancelled). Assigning a task to someone else e-mails them (assignee_notified).

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

application_id.description: Create only: one application of the candidate (position_result.id); the candidate is taken from it.

assignee_profile_id.description: Who does it (profile.id of an active user of the company who can see the candidate or position). Required to create.

candidate_id.description: Create only: the candidate the task is about (profile_interview.id).

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

due_at.description: Due date and time (ISO 8601 with offset). An empty string (or null) removes it; left out keeps it.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional company to act on. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

notes.description: Notes, at most 4000 characters. An empty string (or null) removes them; left out keeps them.

position_id.description: Create only: the position (position_def_set.id) or interview (interview_def_set.id) the task is about.

status.description: open, done or cancelled. Cancelled is final: a cancelled task cannot be changed or reopened.

task_id.description: The task to change (merchant_task.id, from list_tasks).

title.description: Title, 1 to 200 characters. Required to create.

name: save_task
title: Create or change a task
